$doc: Vyomi capability registry — GCP Vertex AI (Gemini publisher models over the local-LLM seam). Proven by tests/conformance/test_capabilities.py.

gcp.vertex-ai.gemini.title: Gemini generateContent / countTokens / streamGenerateContent
limitations: One small local model answers every Gemini model id (llama.cpp on the mesh/appliance, WebLLM on Nano when the page registers one), so quality is toy-grade; with no model running the API returns 503 UNAVAILABLE rather than an answer. Text parts, function calling (functionDeclarations, automatic function calling via google-genai) and responseSchema JSON output work; images/audio/video, grounding/Google Search, code execution, safety settings and tuning are rejected.

gcp.vertex-ai.embeddings.title: Text embeddings (embedContent / predict)
limitations: Embeddings come from the local embedding model when the backend has one; otherwise from vyomi-hash-embed, a deterministic bag-of-words embedding that is stable and cosine-comparable but not semantic. Dimensions are 256, not the real models' 768/3072.

gcp.vertex-ai.model-garden.title: Model Garden (publisher model catalog: list, get, filter)
limitations: A small fixed catalog of Google, Meta, Mistral and partner models. Only Gemini and text-embedding models can be called (local-LLM seam); other models are catalog entries, and 'Deploy' registers a model + endpoint record without a serving container.

gcp.vertex-ai.endpoints.title: Endpoints (create, list, get, delete, deployModel, undeployModel, traffic split)
limitations: Deployed models are recorded and shown with their traffic split, but no container serves them: custom-model :predict / :rawPredict answer 501 UNIMPLEMENTED. Autoscaling and private endpoints are config-only.

gcp.vertex-ai.models.title: Model Registry (upload, list, get, delete, link to endpoints)
limitations: Model records only: artifacts are not validated, versions/aliases and model evaluation are not simulated, models:copy and export answer 501.

gcp.vertex-ai.datasets.title: Datasets (create, list, get, delete)
limitations: Dataset records only: no data items, annotations, import or export are stored.

gcp.vertex-ai.jobs.title: Training pipelines, custom jobs, batch predictions, hyperparameter tuning, pipeline jobs, tuning jobs (create, list, get, cancel, delete)
limitations: Jobs advance PENDING -> RUNNING -> SUCCEEDED on a clock (about 5 seconds) and never run user containers or produce logs/metrics. A succeeded training pipeline registers its modelToUpload in the Model Registry; batch jobs report an output directory but write no predictions.

gcp.vertex-ai.notebooks.title: Workbench instances (notebooks v2) and Colab Enterprise runtimes/templates (create, list, get, start, stop, delete)
limitations: Control-plane records only: no JupyterLab server or VM is started and the proxy URI does not open a notebook.

gcp.vertex-ai.vector-search.title: Vector Search (indexes, index endpoints, deployIndex, upsert/removeDatapoints, findNeighbors)
limitations: Exact brute-force nearest neighbour over the stored datapoints (cosine, dot-product, L1, squared-L2); no ANN tuning, restricts/filters, sparse embeddings or batch index builds from GCS.

gcp.vertex-ai.feature-store.title: Feature Store (feature groups, features, online stores, feature views)
limitations: Registry records only: no BigQuery sync, feature serving or online lookups.

gcp.vertex-ai.experiments.title: Experiments and metadata (metadata store contexts/artifacts/executions, TensorBoard instances/experiments/runs)
limitations: Records created through the API or console; no experiment tracking SDK run logging, time series or lineage graph.

gcp.gemini-developer-api.title: Gemini Developer API (generativelanguage.googleapis.com, API key) - Dev Simplified alias
limitations: Alias of the Vertex Gemini lane for google-genai / REST clients pointed at base_url with an API key: /v1beta|/v1 models list/get, generateContent, streamGenerateContent (alt=sse), countTokens, embedContent, batchEmbedContents. A missing key returns 403 PERMISSION_DENIED; the key itself is not validated. Same model, limits and rejected features as the Vertex Gemini lane; no Files API, caching, Live API, tuning or Imagen/Veo.

gcp.vertex-ai.agent-engine.title: Agent Engine (reasoningEngines create/get/list/update/delete, :query, :streamQuery) - Vyomi agent spec, Dev Simplified
limitations: Dev Simplified: the control plane (aiplatform v1/v1beta1 reasoningEngines with LROs) is real, and :query / :streamQuery really run an agent - but not a pickled/packaged Python class. The agent is a Vyomi agent spec (JSON instructions + declarative tools: static/template/builtin calculator/webhook/in-process function) carried in spec.vyomiAgentSpec (REST) or a spec.deploymentSpec.env entry VYOMI_AGENT_SPEC (typed google-cloud-aiplatform gapic clients, transport='rest'), executed as a tool-calling loop over the local model (llama.cpp on the mesh/appliance, WebLLM on Nano). Class methods query, stream_query/async_stream_query and session helpers (create/get/list/delete_session, multi-turn history) are served; :streamQuery events follow the ADK Event shape inside the REST JSON-array-of-HttpBody framing. vertexai.agent_engines.create(<python object>) (cloudpickle + GCS staging), packageSpec/containerSpec deployment, Memory Bank, Example Store and ADK/LangChain/LangGraph runtimes are not supported; an engine with no spec answers :query with FAILED_PRECONDITION, and no model running returns 503 UNAVAILABLE (never a canned answer). Toy-grade quality; webhook tools need network egress (not in Nano's browser); on Nano the loop re-runs after each model await, so keep tools idempotent. gcloud has no reasoning-engines surface in the stable track - use the SDK or REST. State is in the persisted account bag.

gcp.vertex-ai.rag-engine.title: RAG Engine (ragCorpora, ragFiles upload / import from Cloud Storage, retrieveContexts)
limitations: Files arrive by ragFiles:upload (JSON text, base64 content, or the real multipart/related and multipart/form-data bodies) or ragFiles:import from the simulated Cloud Storage (gcsSource.uris: an object or a prefix; unchanged objects are skipped, changed ones re-imported in place). Text, Markdown, CSV, HTML, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX and text-layer PDF are parsed (pure Python, no layout/OCR parsing; legacy .doc/.xls/.ppt fail per file). Chunks are embedded with the local embedding seam (MiniLM in the browser, nomic on the Mesh; a labelled hash embedder when no model runs) and retrieved by exact cosine kNN (no HNSW); ragRetrievalConfig supports topK, hybridSearch.alpha (weighted rank fusion with BM25; alpha 0 = sparse only), vectorDistanceThreshold / vectorSimilarityThreshold and ranking (rerank = embedding + lexical blend, not Google's rank service). Drive, Slack, Jira and SharePoint sources, Spanner / Pinecone / Weaviate / Vertex Vector Search backends and metadata filters are not supported.

gcp.vertex-ai.search.title: Vertex AI Search (data stores, documents import, engines, servingConfigs:search, generated summary)
limitations: Documents come in inline, or from the simulated Cloud Storage (gcsSource.inputUris with dataSchema content, custom or document; BigQuery, Spanner, Firestore and Cloud SQL imports are rejected). Search ranks by hybrid BM25 + embedding reciprocal rank fusion (semantic candidates need cosine >= 0.3); there is no filter / facet / boost / spell-correction spec and no Google semantic ranker. contentSearchSpec.summarySpec returns a generated, cited summary (summaryWithMetadata.citationMetadata) from the small local chat model (not Gemini); with no model running the response carries summarySkippedReasons LLM_ADDON_NOT_ENABLED instead of failing the search.

gcp.vertex-ai.model-armor.title: Security: Model Armor templates and sanitizeUserPrompt / sanitizeModelResponse
limitations: Templates (RAI filters, prompt-injection and jailbreak, basic sensitive-data protection) are really evaluated by the Bedrock Guardrails engine (keyword + local-embedding scoring, regex PII), so detection is toy-grade, not Google's models. Malicious-URI detection (Safe Browsing) and advanced SDP (Cloud DLP templates) are reported EXECUTION_SKIPPED. No floor settings, no SCC / Cloud Logging findings: the page keeps the last 200 sanitize results of this simulator. Prompt injection applies to user prompts only.

gcp.vertex-ai.agent-gateway.title: Gateways and MCP servers (agentGateways, mcpServers registry)
limitations: Google's Agent Gateway / Agent Registry have no public API to model: these resources are Vyomi's own (vyomiExtension) over the AgentCore gateway engine. A gateway is a real MCP endpoint (POST /gateways/{id}/mcp) with NONE or JWT auth; attaching an MCP server creates a real mcpServer target (API-key header supported) and tools are listed and called through it. The backing AgentCore gateway also shows in the AWS console of the same account (prefixed gcp-). Calling external MCP servers needs network: direct on the Mesh, through the allow-listed egress relay on Nano.

gcp.vertex-ai.agent-policies.title: Policies (agentPolicies: Cedar over a gateway)
limitations: Vyomi's own resource over the AgentCore policy engine: a real Cedar policy (cedarpy) decides each gateway tool call (principal = JWT subject, action = <target>___<tool>, context.input = arguments); ENFORCE denies by default, LOG_ONLY allows and audits. Mesh/appliance decide with cedarpy; Nano with the same Cedar Rust core compiled to WebAssembly (cedar-wasm 4.14.0, vendored, parity-tested against cedarpy). If the evaluator fails to load, an ENFORCE gateway denies every call (fail closed). Google's org-level agent policies are not modelled.

gcp.vertex-ai.provisioned-throughput.title: Provisioned Throughput (bookkeeping)
limitations: A record of a model, generative model units and a commitment term. Nothing is reserved, enforced or billed (a local model has no shared capacity). Google exposes no public create API for it, so the path is a Vyomi extension.
